summary: For Petitioner: Shri M.G Ramachandran, Advocate, DVC Ms.AnushreeBardhan, Advocate, DVC ShriP.Bhattacharya, DVC ShriSubrataGhosal, DVC _Order in Petition No. 351/GT/2014 Page 1 of 29_ _Order in Petition No. 351/GT/2014 Page 2 of 29_ subject to the final outcome of the Civil Appeals pending before the Hon‟ble Supreme Court in respect of the determination of tariff of the generating stations and inter-state transmission systems of the petitioner by the Commission for the periods 2006-09 and 2009-14. _Order in Petition No. 351/GT/2014 Page 3 of 29_ additional information and has served copies on the respondents. None of the respondents have filed any replies regarding the same. Taking into consideration the documents available on record, we proceed to consider the claims of the petitioner and determine the tariff in respect of this generating station for the period 2014-19.The _Order in Petition No. 351/GT/2014 Page 4 of 29_ Commission vide ROP of hearing dated 6.9.2016 had directed the petitioner to submit certain informationandthe petitioner has not submitted anyinformation. _Order in Petition No. 351/GT/2014 Page 5 of 29_ _(i) Liabilities to meet award of arbitration or for compliance of the order or decree of a court of law;_ _Order in Petition No. 351/GT/2014 Page 6 of 29_ _Order in Petition No. 351/GT/2014 Page 7 of 29_ _Order in Petition No. 351/GT/2014 Page 8 of 29_ _Order in Petition No. 351/GT/2014 Page 9 of 29_ _Order in Petition No. 351/GT/2014 Page 10 of 29_ _Order in Petition No. 351/GT/2014 Page 11 of 29_ _Order in Petition No. 351/GT/2014 Page 12 of 29_ _Order in Petition No. 351/GT/2014 Page 13 of 29_ _Order in Petition No. 351/GT/2014 Page 14 of 29_ _Order in Petition No. 351/GT/2014 Page 15 of 29_ _Order in Petition No. 351/GT/2014 Page 16 of 29_ _Order in Petition No. 351/GT/2014 Page 17 of 29_ _Order in Petition No. 351/GT/2014 Page 18 of 29_ _Order in Petition No. 351/GT/2014 Page 19 of 29_ _Order in Petition No. 351/GT/2014 Page 20 of 29_ _Order in Petition No. 351/GT/2014 Page 21 of 29_ 41. In addition, the petitioner has claimed expenditure towards Pension & Gratuity contribution and Cost of Common Offices. We now discuss and decide these elements as detailed below: _Order in Petition No. 351/GT/2014 Page 22 of 29_ 43. We have examined the matter. It is observed that the liability claimed by the petitioner pertains to the period 2009-14 and does not pertain to the tariff period 2014- 19. In this regard it is observed that the Commission in its order dated 29.7.2016 inPetition No. 468/GT/2014, had disallowed the claim of the petitioner and has observed _Order in Petition No. 351/GT/2014 Page 23 of 29_ _Order in Petition No. 351/GT/2014 Page 24 of 29_ _Order in Petition No. 351/GT/2014 Page 25 of 29_ _Order in Petition No. 351/GT/2014 Page 26 of 29_ _Order in Petition No. 351/GT/2014 Page 27 of 29_ 53. The petitioner has sought the reimbursement of filing fee and also the expenses incurred towards publication of notices for application of tariff for the period 2014-19. The petitioner has deposited the filing fees for the period 2014-15 in terms of the provisions of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Payment of Fees) Regulations, 2012. Accordingly, in terms of Regulation 52 of the 2014 Tariff Regulations and in line with the decision in Commission‟s order dated 5.1.2016 in Petition No. 232/GT/2014, we direct that the petitioner shall be entitled to recover pro rata, the filing fees and the expenses incurred on publication of notices for the period 2014-15 directly from the respondents on submission of documentary proof. The filing fees for the remaining years of the tariff period 2015-19 shall be recovered pro rata after deposit of the same and production of documentary proof. _Order in Petition No. 351/GT/2014 Page 28 of 29_ _Order in Petition No. 351/GT/2014 Page 29 of 29_
